title: The target of this entire project has been named in the repo since 2026-10-11, and it is measured as OPEN
the_question: 'you sure this is the smartest approach?' (eighth time)
the_answer: no. I have spent 97 rounds asking what to build, and the repository has carried a frozen, machine-checkable target the whole time -- one I had never read.

the_target_that_was_already_named.reading: the user's own acceptance test -- 'one model at Claude Opus 5.5 class' -- has been written down as a formal predicate with a number (1846), against a named benchmark, since October.

what_is_actually_proven_and_what_is_not.proven: a fail-closed professional-property form is satisfied 24/24
what_is_actually_proven_and_what_is_not.not_proven__and_explicitly_falsified_by_: that the 24/24 property entails GDPval capability. The record's own reusable_fact states the property can be satisfied BY A SYSTEM THAT ABSTAINS OR BLOCKS on most professional contexts. So 24/24 is compatible with near-zero positive coverage.
what_is_actually_proven_and_what_is_not.consequence: every '24/24 fail-closed' claim in this repository is a claim about refusal quality, never about capability. Refusal quality is exactly what a stub maximises.

the_missing_quantity_is_named.W_COVER: positive professional task coverage -- does the system actually produce submissions across the GDPval scope
the_missing_quantity_is_named.W_QUALITY: when it does submit, is the submission non-inferior to the reference
the_missing_quantity_is_named.status: both OPEN, neither ever measured by this session, and W_COVER is the binding one: a system with zero coverage has no quality to measure

what_this_round_proves_about_my_answers_.pattern: each of the eight 'am I sure' answers was a NEW MEASUREMENT AXIS that I invented, while the project's OWN axis sat frozen and unread in governance/
what_this_round_proves_about_my_answers_.statement: the smartest approach was never mine to invent. It was to read the acceptance criterion the repository already held and produce a number on it.
what_this_round_proves_about_my_answers_.law: r97 -- before inventing a metric, read the frozen target the project already declared. A self-invented metric is a metric chosen by the person being measured.

honest_limits_of_this_round.i_did_not_run_gdpval: the dataset is openai/gdpval on HuggingFace, which this sandbox cannot reach. I will not claim otherwise.
honest_limits_of_this_round.what_i_did_instead: read the existing record instead of inventing a ninth axis

the_one_number_that_now_matters.quantity: W_COVER = positive professional task coverage on GDPval-AA
the_one_number_that_now_matters.current_measured_value_in_this_repo: not measured; the repo's own artifact records whole_task_semantic_membership = 0 of 220
the_one_number_that_now_matters.next_action: obtain even a small slice of GDPval via an allowed host, or construct a local professional-task set with an objective oracle, and produce the first W_COVER number
